# Kinship Test Fixtures

## mouse_hs1940.cXX.txt

JAMMA-computed reference kinship matrix used by the kinship tests in
`tests/test_kinship.py` and the equivalence demonstration in
`scripts/demonstrate_equivalence.py`.

**Source dataset:** `tests/fixtures/mouse_hs1940/mouse_hs1940` (1940 samples,
12226 SNPs)
**Generated by:** `jamma -gk 1` (centered relatedness matrix)

## gemma_ref.cXX.txt

GEMMA-computed reference kinship matrix on the same dataset, used as the
GEMMA-parity reference for kinship validation.

GEMMA builds the matrix over all 1940 samples but measures the MAF and
missingness filters over the 1410 phenotyped ones, keeping 10768 of 12226
SNPs. `jamma -gk 1` does the same, and
`tests/test_pipeline_kinship.py::test_gk_cli_matches_gemma_reference_kinship`
pins the two matrices together at `kinship_rtol`.

Generated with:

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/data \
  quay.io/biocontainers/gemma:0.98.5--ha36d3ea_0 \
  gemma -bfile /data/tests/fixtures/mouse_hs1940/mouse_hs1940 \
        -gk 1 -o gemma_ref \
        -outdir /data/tests/fixtures/kinship
```

## Regeneration

To regenerate the JAMMA reference:

```bash
uv run jamma -bfile tests/fixtures/mouse_hs1940/mouse_hs1940 \
             -gk 1 \
             -outdir tests/fixtures/kinship \
             -o mouse_hs1940
```

After regenerating, refresh the fixture manifest so the pre-commit gate
accepts the new SHA-256:

```bash
uv run python scripts/check_fixture_manifest.py --write
```

The manifest (`tests/fixtures/MANIFEST.toml`) tracks the SHA-256 of every
git-tracked fixture; `scripts/check_fixture_manifest.py` runs as a pre-commit
hook and as a tier0 self-test (`tests/test_fixture_manifest.py`). Committing
a fixture without updating the manifest will fail.
